notes: No kb/Work note owns the fix. §1985:VI.6.21.2 prints four formats (plain, TIMES, UNTIL with an optional WITH TEST BEFORE or AFTER, and VARYING with AFTER phrases), each out-of-line over procedure-name-1 [THROUGH or THRU procedure-name-2] or inline over imperative-statement-1 END-PERFORM, and it underlines BY in the VARYING phrase and in every AFTER phrase. performStatement and its phrase rules parse the superset, BindPerform and BindPerformControl bind one control phrase, and the later editions' additions are refused at 85 on recognition (COBOL0900): an omitted BY by VisitPerformVarying and VisitPerformVaryingAfter, UNTIL EXIT by VisitPerformUntilTarget, the exception-checking format by VisitPerformStatement, and AFTER in an inline PERFORM (§1985:VI.6.21.3 SR2) by VisitPerformVaryingAfter. Probed at --std 85: every format out-of-line and inline, THRU and THROUGH, WITH omitted, index-names in VARYING and FROM, six AFTER phrases all run; a second control phrase, TEST after UNTIL, an empty inline body, END-PERFORM after a procedure-name, a non-integer, zero or signed integer-1, and an arithmetic expression in FROM or BY (COBOL2119) are refused. What is NOT implemented is the BY brace: the format prints BY identifier-4 or literal-2 (identifier-7 or literal-4 in AFTER), with no index-name alternative such as FROM has, yet BindVaryingOperand classifies a BY operand through Classify, which returns the IndexName kind for an index-name, and neither it nor CheckVaryingOperandRules refuses that kind in the BY slot, so BY index-name compiles and augments by the index's occurrence number. The gap has no edition arm (the 2023 varying-phrase prints the same brace and --std 2023 accepts the same program). The witness runs the four formats with identifier and literal BY operands only.

next.reason: §1985:VI.6.21.2 gives four PERFORM formats (simple, TIMES, UNTIL, VARYING), each out-of-line or inline, with BY required in every VARYING and AFTER phrase. §2023:14.9.28.2 recasts them as 'Format 1 (out-of-line)' and 'Format 2 (inline)' over times-phrase, until-phrase and varying-phrase; every 1985 PERFORM still fits and means the same, but the 2023 format accepts programs the 1985 one refuses: BY is bracketed (its meaning given by §2023:14.9.28.4 GR12, 'For any BY phrase that is omitted, the augment value is 1'), UNTIL EXIT is added, the inline varying-phrase takes AFTER, which §1985:VI.6.21.3 SR2 forbade ('if procedure-name-1 is omitted, the AFTER phrase must not be specified'; 2023 has no such rule), and a 'Format 3 (exception-checking)' is added. Wider syntax, nothing made an exception condition: CHANGED. The syntax rules each carry their own 1985 rule, so the record names the format.
